notice: FICTIONAL DEMO DATA. Requirement docs for the themes in triage.json.

requirements.problem: Operators calculate guide pay in spreadsheets from tour lists, per-tour or per-guest rates and tips. It takes days every month and causes disputes with freelance guides.
goals: Show the amount owed to each guide for a chosen period
Support per-tour, per-guest and hourly rates
Include tips and split them between guide and driver
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can open a payout summary per guide for any date range
Summary lists each tour, the rate applied and the total
Admin can send a guide their summary by email before they invoice
openQuestions: How are tips split when several staff work one departure?
Do we need to export payouts to accounting software in v1?

requirements.problem: Delays, duplicates and missing product changes in the Bokun integration lead to overbookings, refunds and manual clean-up.
goals: Keep availability in sync within minutes
Pick up product changes without manual re-import
acceptanceCriteria: A booking made in Bokun appears within 5 minutes with the correct participant count
Re-delivered webhooks do not create a second booking
New departure times created in Bokun appear automatically
openQuestions: Should operators be alerted when the sync fails?

requirements.problem: Confirmations show only the tour start time, so guests do not know when to wait at their hotel and drivers have no pickup list.
goals: Show the per-hotel pickup time in confirmations
Let operators shift pickup times for a whole departure
Give drivers a pickup list per vehicle
acceptanceCriteria: Confirmation email contains the pickup point and time
Changing a departure's pickup time notifies all guests on it
Pickup list can be printed per vehicle, sorted by time
openQuestions: SMS or email for last-minute time changes?

requirements.problem: Schools, cruise groups and agencies book 10–50 seats at once, but each seat is handled as a separate booking with manual discounts.
goals: Create one booking for a whole group
Hold seats for agencies and release unused ones
acceptanceCriteria: Headcount of a group booking can be edited in one place
Held seats are released automatically at a set number of days before departure
openQuestions: Do held seats count as sold for OTA availability?

requirements.problem: Operators recreate invoices manually because the system cannot add the client's company details or show different VAT rates per line.
goals: Add company name and VAT ID to invoices
Show VAT rates per line item
acceptanceCriteria: Customer can enter company details at checkout
Invoice PDF lists net, VAT rate and gross per line
openQuestions: Which countries' invoice rules do we support first?

requirements.problem: When tours sell out, operators collect interested customers by email and contact them by hand after cancellations.
goals: Let customers join a waitlist for sold-out departures
acceptanceCriteria: Sold-out departure offers a waitlist sign-up
On cancellation, the first person on the waitlist is notified automatically
openQuestions: Should the freed spot be held for the notified person, and for how long?
